candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Because we charge per session, I find the "2 sessions/day, 2 days/week, for the date ranges given at each site" breakdown tricky. Our schedule doesn't always fit that format neatly; for example, in one week we might hold only 2 sessions rather than 4. The grand total therefore comes from the total session count—for HPI, that is $9,450 (18 sessions x $525).

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Since that's the amount he gave in the email, using it seems to make sense to me.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text:
Could you make these revisions as well? Sorry, I have changes for these two budgets. For NCA, the allocated budget for NH is $18750; the start date was 9/8, and it ends on 10/20.

The site labeled 286R, which is actually 201, has a budget of $16200. They started on 9/3 and will also end on 10/22. She also said:

"The number of weeks served on Annex B Page 5 is incorrect. It is listed as 11.5 weeks, but the correct total is 7 weeks. Please update the number ASAP so we can ensure everything is accurate and the payments are correct."

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: Nca and Nh refer to the same school.

candidates.speaker: client
candidates.text: 1\. Follow the same approach used for HPI, but put the difference only in approved lines such as travel and consumable supplies. 2. Since she did not provide a contract ID, use 286R; it is confusing because the funding comes from one school while the program is hosted at another location. 3. The NCA contract ID is the same situation—it was not provided. 4. Use the numbers she supplied when I asked, although I don't think she knows the correct answer. 5. To keep everything consistent, apply the dates she gave us to all of the date fields. She has been especially difficult to work with and still hasn't supplied the information we need for our schedules, so hopefully the documents won't get kicked back again.
